name: scrollsim2-scan
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Four panels: the same synthetic crop of papyrus windings three times, first plain, then with synchrotron settings (sharper sheet edges with a bright rim, fine grainy noise and faint rings), then with lab settings (softer, blotchier noise, stronger rings and slightly darker sheets toward the middle of the roll); the fourth panel is a line chart of each version's noise power against frequency on a log scale.
caption: Synthetic demo: one ScrollSim v2 crop under no scan model, --scan synchrotron and --scan lab, with each noise power spectrum. No scan data.
